referenceFunction.generalComment: This dataset describes the treatment of a used electric drivetrain of an electric scooter. The original dataset has been developed for a drivetrain comprising an electric motor (5.8kg), a controller (1.27kg) and a charger (3.025). First, the drivetrain is manually dismantled to recover all large metal scrap, especially from the electric motor and from the cases of the electronic devices. The scrap steel, copper and aluminium directly recovered from the components is sent to the respective scrap recycling facilities, while the remaining electronics scrap is sent to a smelter facility.; UUID: cedf5dd7-8a33-35a4-a87c-309d691ec658
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The dataset starts with the electric drivetrain which needs to be dismantled already in the dismantling facility. The dataset returns the outcome scrap fractions for aluminium, steel, copper, plastic and waste electronics.
